Create a Dataverse dataset and upload a configured source file

Source: R/dataverse.R
upload_source.Rd

Creates a CC0 dataset under parent, then uploads the local source file named by the YAML source config. This creates a draft; it does not publish the dataset. An existing dataset$doi is reused; otherwise a dataset is created and its DOI saved before the file upload. On successful upload, the numeric file ID and local MD5 are saved as database_id and source_md5. A file's doi is left untouched until publication. Refuses to upload when a top-level file doi or database_id is already set, to avoid uploading the same source twice.

Usage

upload_source(
  config_path,
  contact_name = Sys.getenv("DV_POC_NAME"),
  contact_email = Sys.getenv("DV_POC_EMAIL"),
  file_source = "{project_root}/source_files/{state}/{vintage}_{years}",
  parent = "mortalityrecords",
  token = Sys.getenv("DV_API_TOKEN")
)

Arguments

config_path

Path to a YAML source config containing filename, state, years, and server. An optional dataset mapping requires title, agency, and vintage; doi, description, and public_records_law are optional. Without dataset, its required fields are prompted for and written to the config before creation. New datasets require a YYYY-MM-DD dataset$vintage.

contact_name, contact_email

Dataset contact details. Defaults to DV_POC_NAME and DV_POC_EMAIL environment variables.

file_source

Directory containing the configured file; supports the same template tokens as fetch_source_file()'s file_destination.

parent

Alias of the parent Dataverse ("root" for the root).

token

Dataverse API token; defaults to DV_API_TOKEN. Never put credentials in source configs.

Value

Invisibly, the parsed response to the file upload.
